data.name: Erlina
data.gender_notes: Erlina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Erlina is derived from the Old German words ‘er’ meaning ‘earth’ or ‘soil’ and ‘lina’ meaning ‘soft’ or ‘tender’. This name evokes images of a gentle and nurturing spirit, much like a mountain that provides a stable foundation and shelter. The name Erlina carries the meaning “Gentle mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erlina usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the tender and caring nature of the earth.
data.etymology: Erlina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erlina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
